title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-03
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Master Soundboard 10" Reel @15ips 1/2trk > Dat (16/48); Transfer Info: Sony PCM-R500 (16/48) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > TLH flac1648

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a summer‑66 set with psychedelic jams and standout tracks like Viola Lee, Big Boss and Sittin’, though sections are missing.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clear soundboard feed that showcases the early‑summer ’66 vibe – psychedelic pop, tight jams and Pigpen’s organ flourishes. Reviewers love the standout performances of Viola Lee, Big Boss, Sittin’, Don’t Ease and Stealin’, but note dropouts and missing portions that detract from a fully immersive experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several praised songs and excellent soundboard clarity, offset by reported dropouts/missing sections.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear SBD capture noted as fabulous, but some reviewers mention drops, cuts and significant missing portions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑summer ’66 set flows from psychedelic pop into extended jams, delivering a lively and enjoyable atmosphere despite some missing tracks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work praised as "sweet licks" with classic summer‑66 tone.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ playing highlighted as a key element of the show.
